> 第十八章 巧了（第1页）
铸魔洞窟内，李磊将那几件宝物重新装入乾坤袋中，收拾好后李磊二话不说，立刻转身掉头朝出口处飞奔而去。
他实在不想在这个破地方多待一秒，多浪费一分时间了。
但并不是因为李磊胆小，主要是这铸魔洞窟属实有些诡异，仿佛有无尽的秘密还没有被李磊发觉出来。
另外一个原因，李磊真的很赶时间，他实在是太想飞升成仙，太想知道天上到底是什么样子。
他这种情绪就好比谁家小孩拆生日礼物，一旦得到了生日礼物，就必须立刻马上拆开，否则那就是一种煎熬。
“你怎么这么着急要投胎啊，不在这歇息会就走吗”石头笑着问道。
“对对对，我去投胎，你说啥是啥!”李磊应付道。
李磊眼看马上就要出去了，可是，铸魔洞窟洞口突然出现一个金色的屏障，正正好好把洞口给封上了。
面对这突如其来的屏障李磊更是措手不及，根本没有办法停下脚步，只好以最快的速度结结实实的撞向屏障，没错刚才那声惨叫就是李磊发出的。
“奶奶的，给我玩阴的是吧，破石头不让我出去就直说”李磊捂着头上刚撞还热乎的包骂道，可以看出这力道可真是不小，但那金色的屏障却丝毫没有损伤。
石头就仿佛没有听到李磊刚才的谩骂，自顾自的笑道。
李磊还偏不信这个邪了，走到屏障面前，用自己的拳头腿脚狂风暴雨般的对这屏障输出。
明明只是拳头轰向屏障，却硬生生的弄出了打铁般的声音。
李磊瘫坐在地上，看着自己已经青的发紫的双手，又看了看毫发无损的屏障，李磊彻底摆烂了。
“我事先说明一下，不要发生什么事，都赖在我头上，这根本不是铸魔洞窟做的，更不是我做的，我只是一块小小的石头而已不是吗”石头笑嘻嘻的说道。
可以看出，这石头的快乐已经完全建立在李磊的痛苦之上了。
“你不会仔细看看吗?那屏障的气息!和这铸魔洞窟一样吗，和我的气息一样吗?你这个呆瓜，无语了”
李磊仔细打量观察了那屏障一番，他发现这屏障还真不是石头以及铸魔洞窟的手段，这屏障所散发的气息是那般的神圣威严，完完全全和石头的魔气成了鲜明的对比。
“这是天上的手段?他们要干什么”李磊问道。
“没错这就是天上的手段，束升大阵!至于用途嘛，当然是用来找你的了”
“飞升时那般动静不找你才怪!束升大阵岂以你这般修为能够损坏的吗，至少要金仙境界才有可能……”
“好你个石头，让我错过大机缘了，我的飞黄腾达的大机缘啊”李磊简直欲哭无泪了。
“你就庆幸吧你，这不就是巧了吗，把你隔在这里，你以为是大机缘?天庭只要发现你有危险就一定会把你扼杀在摇篮之中，把你找到只是先控制住你而已”石头愤愤的说道。
李磊听到了此话顿时情绪舒缓了一些但依旧有些抑郁。
“根据我推断这大阵需要持续一天的时间，在这前期你是根本出不去的，要不你再锤一会屏障?”石头笑着问道。

> Chapter 18 What a coincidence (Page 1)
In the Demon Casting Cave, Li Lei put the treasures back into the Qiankun Bag. After packing them up, Li Lei immediately turned around and ran towards the exit without saying a word.
He really didn't want to stay in this crappy place for one more second and waste one more minute of time.
But it's not because Li Lei is timid, the main reason is that the Demon Casting Cave is really weird, as if there are endless secrets that Li Lei has not discovered yet.
Another reason is that Li Lei is really in a hurry. He really wants to ascend to immortality and know what the sky is like.
His emotion is like a child opening a birthday present. Once he gets a birthday present, he must open it immediately, otherwise it will be a torture.
"Why are you so anxious to be reincarnated? Why don't you just leave here if you don't want to rest here?" Shitou asked with a smile.
"Yes, yes, yes, I'm going to be reincarnated, whatever you say is what I want!" Li Lei responded.
Li Lei was about to leave, but a golden barrier suddenly appeared at the entrance of the Demon Casting Cave, sealing the entrance.
Facing this sudden barrier, Li Lei was caught off guard. He had no way to stop and had no choice but to slam into the barrier as fast as possible. Yes, the scream just now was made by Li Lei.
"Grandma, you're playing tricks on me, right? Just tell me if you won't let me out." Li Lei covered his head with the hot bag that had just hit him and cursed. It could be seen that the force was really strong, but the golden barrier was not damaged at all.
Shitou seemed to have not heard Li Lei's curse just now, and smiled to himself.
Li Lei still didn't believe this evil, so he walked up to the barrier and used his fists, legs and feet to attack the barrier like a storm.
It was obviously just a fist hitting the barrier, but it made a sound like iron.
Li Lei collapsed on the ground, looking at his already blue and purple hands, and then at the undamaged barrier. Li Lei was completely shattered.
"Let me explain in advance, if anything happens, it will be all on my head. This was not done by the Demon Casting Cave at all, let alone me. I am just a small stone, right?" Shitou said with a smile.
It can be seen that the joy of this stone is completely based on Li Lei's pain.
"Won't you take a closer look? The breath of that barrier! Is it the same as this Demon Casting Cave? Is it the same as my breath? You idiot, I'm speechless."
Li Lei looked at the barrier carefully, and he found that the barrier was really not made of stone or the Demonic Cave. The aura exuded by the barrier was so sacred and majestic, in stark contrast to the demonic energy of the stone.
"Is this a method from heaven? What are they going to do?" Li Lei asked.
"Yes, this is heaven's means, the Shusheng Formation! As for its purpose, of course it is used to find you."
"It's strange that I didn't look for you when I was so commotion during the ascension! How can the Shusheng Formation be damaged with your cultivation level? At least you have to be in the Golden Immortal realm..."
"You're such a stone, I missed a great opportunity, a great opportunity for my great success." Li Lei was about to cry without tears.
"Just be lucky. Isn't this just a coincidence? Do you think it's a great opportunity to separate you here? As long as Heaven discovers that you are in danger, it will strangle you in the cradle. To find you is just to control you first," Shitou said angrily.
After hearing this, Li Lei felt relieved but was still a little depressed.
"According to my inference, this formation will last for a day. You won't be able to get out at all in this early stage. How about you hammer down the barrier again?" Shitou asked with a smile.
